title: Simple Skyblock
description: A datapack that adds a lot of unobtainable items to the skyblock experience.
body:
This datapack aims to make a lot of unobtainable items obtainable in Minecraft skyblock. Most of it's features are meant to be used in combination with [Skyblock Standard](https://modrinth.com/datapack/standard-skyblock) by [BPR02](https://modrinth.com/user/BPR02). Not all items are obtainable, mostly due to them not being _that_ useful in skyblock, but it improves the obtainable item count a lot in Skyblock.

You can try to figure out how to obtain all these items on your own, but there is the [wiki](https://codeberg.org/legoraft/simple-skyblock/wiki) if you get stuck on figuring out some of the mechanics.
